zh.d:
本版桌面端的重头是两件事：换机不再是重头再来（备份与恢复），以及内置网络搜索让智能体能回答「现在」的问题。另有一批围绕长会话的状态呈现修复。

【新增】
· 系统设置新增备份与恢复：按类别（会话、模型配置、技能等）挑选要带走的数据，导出归档文件；恢复按类别合并而不是整库替换——只含会话的归档不会清掉目标机器上的模型配置，应用前确认框会说明这一点。备份完成后文件路径留在界面上、可一键打开所在文件夹；附件不再默认打进备份（在开发机上这一个类别就有 13,304 个文件 / 228 MB、耗时约半小时），勾选后才会包含
· 内置网络搜索：内置智谱、豆包、阿里云、腾讯元器四个搜索提供方，支持编辑端点、自定义提供方和一键连通性测试；不再要求先去某家申请 API Key 才能用——不填 Key 时走内置通道开箱即用；智谱搜索可选档位，无链接的搜索结果不再被丢弃
· 上下文窗口默认 1M；用量过 80% 时工具栏直接提醒「该压缩了」——此前只有一枚 20px 的圆环变色、数字藏在悬停浮层里，会话经常一路开到引擎「上下文窗口将满」的硬拦截都没有人提醒过你；供应商以「放不下」拒绝请求时会自动恢复并说明；压缩失败的原因现在说人话，全部 13 种语言
· 「在等你」和「还在干活」分得开了：会话因工具确认或向用户提问而停下时，侧边栏和会话内都会出现警示色的「需要注意」标记，不用再逐个打开找那个已经静坐十分钟的智能体
· 会话里的 Mermaid 图可以平移缩放了（滚轮仍留给页面滚动，长对话里路过图表不会误缩放）；会话与预览面板都支持渲染 WaveDrom 时序图
· 会话完成的系统通知里带上会话名；文件树新增「全部折叠」
· 外观设置按区域（全局 / 会话 / Markdown / 代码）选择字体族和字重，候选来自系统已装字体；某区域不设则继承全局
· 媒体：消息本身在要图或要视频时自动切到生成模式——此前输入框上的生成开关默认关着，「画一只猫」会被交给文本模型，得到一段对猫的文字描述或一只 ASCII 猫；从欢迎页生成图片后的追问也会继续留在生成模式里

【优化改进】
· 读图先走本机 OCR，读不动再落到视觉模型；本机 OCR 的结果不再自称「精确转写」
· 预览面板里不在屏幕上的标签页也能弹出右键菜单，并补充了标签页操作和最大化切换；「新建团队」对话框可以拖开，不再挡着底下的内容；团队成员的供应商配额用尽时，通知会说明是谁

【修复】
· 一轮对话结束后输入框一直转圈显示「处理中」，只有切走再切回来才消——「进行中」由三个标志取或，收尾只清了两个
· 打字快时连按回车，斜杠命令会原样作为普通消息发出去，而不是执行该命令
· Markdown 表格的表头与表体行错位
· WebUI 桥接 WebSocket 持续失败时形成重连风暴：重连频率跟着消息发送量走而不是退避间隔，连接「成功即重置退避」，且因认证失败已被停掉的连接会被一条 emit 悄悄复活
· 空白会话标题点不了、无法重命名
· 没有选择模型时静默替你选了一个，而不是明确报出来
· 发送框里一段重复的规则块被删掉；草稿按钮尺寸与输入框对齐
· 设置页里助手、智能体、技能卡片的边框一直是全透明的：卡片底色与所在页面同值，边框又要等到悬停才出现，静止时卡片完全看不出轮廓。现与专家市场卡片一致——静止即有边框，悬停强调
· Agnes 图片：引用图移入 extra_body 字段按其要求的格式发送；agnes-ai.cn 域名能被识别、视频模式按其实际能力匹配；Agnes 3.0 Flash 本身会读图，不再因为不在能力清单里而被晾在一边、改由第二个模型或误字的 OCR 代答

本版补齐了资源分发的最后几个缺口，并把 license 与部署环境绑得更紧。以下改进运行在企业服务端，更新服务端后生效。

【新增】
· 资源包：技能 / MCP 包文件、数字员工 ZIP 上传、RAG 库、登录风险闸门与管理后台页面一并交付；MCP 注册表接受 zip 上传与 README，数字员工包能解开内层的 skill.zip 直接绑定
· API 资产可对声明的端点做探测，并直接发布为 MCP 工具；配置集新增别名 / 作用域 / 启用开关，未启用的保险库不再进入展开范围
· license 收紧：离线 license 与客户请求绑定；未认证的付费档位一律拒绝；校验器与签发方口径对齐；管理后台的 license 详情页显示部署指纹，核对绑定关系一眼可查
· 平台集成：保存的端点可做 HTTP/TCP 探测；SMTP 启用后邀请邮件走企业自己的中继；租户可登记 IM 管道与外观 / 风险 / 市场的 JSON 配置
· 系统管理员可以重置成员密码；改密码只吊销该成员自己的会话
· 管理后台：向量化运维与交接状态呈现补齐，新增可观测性与治理页面

【修复】
· 飞书 SSO 令牌交换失败时能看到对方返回的真实原因（密钥错误 / code 已消费 / 重定向不匹配）——此前一律只显示「HTTP 400」
· 管理后台资源授权矩阵页会循环重复请求有效授权；审批弹窗关不掉、侧边栏点击偶发失灵
· 客户端断开连接不再与未授权会话混为同一个提示
· 团队下发的技能绑定 ID 现在并入成员的技能列表；团队资源绑定值逐项校验

企业服务端与桌面客户端独立更新，需要获取对应版本请与我们联系。

en.d:
The two headline items this release are backup and restore — moving machines no longer means starting over — and built-in web search, so the agent can finally answer questions about "now". A batch of long-session status fixes rides along.

[New]
· System settings gain backup and restore: pick which categories of data (conversations, model configuration, skills and so on) to carry, write an archive, and restore merges per category rather than replacing wholesale — a conversations-only archive cannot wipe the model configuration on the target machine, and the confirm dialog says so before applying. Once a backup finishes, its path stays on screen with a button to reveal the file; attachments no longer join the backup by default (on one developer machine that category alone was 13,304 files / 228 MB, about half an hour) — tick it explicitly to include them
· Built-in web search: four built-in providers — Zhipu, Doubao, Aliyun, Tencent WSA — with editable endpoints, a custom provider option and a one-click connectivity test. It no longer requires first applying for some vendor's API key: with no key supplied, the built-in channel works out of the box; Zhipu's search tier is selectable, and results without links are no longer dropped
· The context window defaults to 1M; past 80% the toolbar tells you plainly to compact — previously only a 20px ring changed colour with the numbers behind a hover popover, and a session could run all the way into the engine's "context window nearly full" block with nothing having nudged you. A provider rejecting the prompt as too long now recovers automatically and explains; what a failed compaction means is stated in plain words, in all 13 languages
· "Waiting for you" is told apart from "still working": when a conversation pauses on a tool confirmation or a question for the user, the sidebar and the conversation both show a warning-toned attention marker, instead of you opening each one to find the agent that had been sitting still for ten minutes
· Mermaid diagrams in chat can now be panned and zoomed (the wheel is still left to page scrolling, so scrolling past a diagram never zooms it); WaveDrom timing diagrams render in both chat and the preview panel
· Turn-completed notifications name the conversation; the file tree gains Collapse All
· Appearance settings take a font family and weight per region (global / chat / Markdown / code), enumerated from the fonts the OS reports; a region with none set inherits the global one
· Media: when the message itself asks for a picture or a video, generation mode switches on automatically — the send box's generation toggle defaulted to off, so "draw me a cat" went to a text model and came back as a description of a cat or an ASCII cat; follow-ups to an image generated from the welcome page now stay in generation mode too

[Improved]
· Reading an image tries on-device OCR first and only falls back to the vision model when it cannot; local OCR no longer describes itself as an exact transcription
· Tabs scrolled off-screen in the preview panel get their context menu back, plus tab actions and a maximize toggle; the New Team dialog can be dragged aside; when a teammate's provider runs out of quota, the notification says whose

[Fixed]
· After a turn finished, the send box kept its spinner and "processing" caption until you switched conversations and back — three "in progress" flags were OR-ed together and the finish path cleared only two
· Pressing Enter quickly while typing fast sent the raw "/command" as an ordinary message instead of executing it
· Markdown table headers did not line up with their body rows
· The WebUI bridge websocket formed a reconnect storm under repeated failures: the reconnect rate tracked how often the app emitted events rather than the backoff interval, backoff reset on "open", and a connection shut down by a terminal auth error was silently resurrected by the next emit
· A blank conversation title was not clickable to rename
· With no model picked, one was silently chosen for you instead of the gap being reported
· A duplicated rule block in the send box is gone; the draft button now matches the composer's size
· Assistant, agent and skill cards in settings had fully transparent borders: the card's fill equalled the surface behind it and the border only appeared on hover, so at rest nothing read as a card. They now match the expert marketplace cards — a visible border at rest, emphasized on hover
· Agnes image: reference images move into the extra_body field in the shape the site asks for; the agnes-ai.cn host is recognised and its video mode matched to what it actually serves; Agnes 3.0 Flash reads images with its own eyes instead of sitting idle off the capability list while a second model, or an OCR pass that misreads characters, answered in its place

This release closes the last gaps in resource distribution and binds licenses more tightly to the deployment. Everything below runs on the enterprise server and takes effect once that server is updated.

[New]
· Resource packs: skill / MCP pack files, employee ZIP upload, RAG libraries, login risk gating and the admin console SPA ship together; the MCP registry accepts zip uploads and READMEs, and an employee pack can unpack an inner skill.zip and bind it directly
· API assets can probe their declared endpoints and be published straight as MCP tools; config sets gain alias / scope / enabled, so unused vaults stay out of expansion
· Licences tighten up: offline licences bind to the customer's request; unauthenticated paid tiers fail closed; the verifier aligns with the provisioner's terms; the console's licence detail page shows the deployment fingerprint, so checking a binding is one glance
· Platform integrations: saved endpoints get HTTP/TCP probes; with SMTP enabled, invite mail goes out through the company's own relay; tenants can register IM pipelines and appearance / risk / marketplace JSON configuration
· System administrators can reset a member's password; a password change revokes only that member's own sessions
· Admin console: embedding operations and handoff statuses are finished, and new observability and governance surfaces land

[Fixed]
· A failed Feishu SSO token exchange now surfaces the reason the provider returned (bad secret / consumed code / redirect mismatch) — previously every failure read as a bare "HTTP 400"
· The console's resource grant matrix page refetched effective grants in a loop; the approval modal would not close and sidebar clicks misfired
· A client disconnecting is no longer reported as an unauthorized session
· Team-distributed skill bindings now merge into a member's skill list; team resource bindings are validated field by field

The enterprise server and the desktop client update independently; contact us for the matching server build.
